exposure: Plan to deliver at health institution
cohort: 398 mothers who gave birth within one year prior to the study in Debre Markos town, Ethiopia
finding: This study found that planning to deliver at a health institution and having a labor duration of less than six hours were positively associated with maternal satisfaction on delivery service, while spontaneous vaginal delivery was inversely related.
mod_finding: Mothers who gave birth via spontaneous vaginal delivery had lower satisfaction on delivery service.
